cc:Work.dc:title: Actual and combined-prediction poverty clusters
cc:Work.dc:description: Municipal LISA classifications, Bolivia, 2017. Actual SDG 1 No Poverty achievement index versus random-fold combined out-of-fold predictions. Queen-repaired contiguity, 999 permutations, seed 12345, p < 0.05. Poverty cluster: low-low achievement; low-poverty cluster: high-high achievement. Outlier is shown with both original high-low and low-high colors. No significant cluster is not missing data. All four views pass _fourview.verify_against_paper before this two-panel map is written.
